Detailed Description

The Simplified Land-surface Model (SLM) supplies lower-boundary sensible-heat, latent-heat, and momentum fluxes for land cells.

The original formulation and evaluation of SLM are documented in Lee and Khairoutdinov (2015), "A Simplified Land Model (SLM) for use in cloud-resolving models: Formulation and evaluation," Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems, 7, 1368–1392, https://doi.org/10.1002/2014MS000419.

SLM includes selected formulations adapted from NoahMP, updates inherited from gSAM-SLM, and SLM-specific corrections to the surface energy and water budgets. It remains a simplified land model and is not a complete implementation of NoahMP.

void SLM::init_from_inputs ( )

Initialize SLM from inputs.

Initializes for idealized cases if provided:

  • Reads uniform land, vegetation, soil, and surface-property inputs.
  • Reads layer-dependent soil properties when not using WRFInput. Initializes other options:
  • Configures soil nudging and relaxation-height values.
  • Loads optional Noah-MP parameter tables and radiation settings.

5723  ParallelFor( box, [=] AMREX_GPU_DEVICE (int i, int j, int)
5724  {
5725  if (landmask_arr(i, j, 0) != 1) {
5726  return;
5727  }

5729  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5730  // Local variables for radiation calculation (all arrays from NOAHMP RADIATION subroutine)
5731  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5732  constexpr amrex::Real MPE = 1.0E-6;
5733  constexpr int NBAND = 2;
5734  amrex::Real fage; //snow age function (0 - new snow)
5735  amrex::Real albgrd[2]; //ground albedo (direct)
5736  amrex::Real albgri[2]; //ground albedo (diffuse)
5737  amrex::Real albd[2]; //surface albedo (direct)
5738  amrex::Real albi[2]; //surface albedo (diffuse)
5739  amrex::Real fabd[2]; //flux abs by veg (per unit direct flux)
5740  amrex::Real fabi[2]; //flux abs by veg (per unit diffuse flux)
5741  amrex::Real ftdd[2]; //down direct flux below veg (per unit dir flux)
5742  amrex::Real ftid[2]; //down diffuse flux below veg (per unit dir flux)
5743  amrex::Real ftii[2]; //down diffuse flux below veg (per unit dif flux)
5744  amrex::Real frevd[2], frevi[2], fregd[2], fregi[2];
5745  amrex::Real albsnd[2]; //snow albedo (direct)
5746  amrex::Real albsni[2]; //snow albedo (diffuse)
5747  amrex::Real ftdi[2]; //down direct flux below veg per unit dif flux = 0
5748 
5749  amrex::Real fsha; //shaded fraction of canopy
5750  amrex::Real vai; //total LAI + stem area index, one sided
5751  amrex::Real fsun; //sunlit fraction of canopy (-)
5752  amrex::Real laisun; //sunlit leaf area (-)
5753  amrex::Real laisha; //shaded leaf area (-)
5754  amrex::Real parsun; //average absorbed par for sunlit leaves (w/m2)
5755  amrex::Real parsha; //average absorbed par for shaded leaves (w/m2)
5756  amrex::Real sav; //solar radiation absorbed by vegetation (w/m2)
5757  amrex::Real sag; //solar radiation absorbed by ground (w/m2)
5758  amrex::Real fsa; //total absorbed solar radiation (w/m2)
5759  amrex::Real fsr; //total reflected solar radiation (w/m2)
5760  amrex::Real fsrv; //veg. reflected solar radiation (w/m2)
5761  amrex::Real fsrg; //ground reflected solar radiation (w/m2)
5762  amrex::Real bgap, wgap;
5763  amrex::Real gdir; //average projected leaf/stem area in solar direction
5764  amrex::Real ext; //optical depth direct beam per unit leaf + stem area
5765  amrex::Real xl_diag_val, chil_diag_val, phi1_diag_val, phi2_diag_val; //diagnostic outputs
5766 
5767  amrex::Real rho[2]; //leaf/stem reflectance weighted by fraction LAI and SAI
5768  amrex::Real tau[2]; //leaf/stem transmittance weighted by fraction LAI and SAI
5769  amrex::Real wl, ws; //fraction of LAI+SAI that is LAI/SAI
5770 
5771  // Get input values
5772  amrex::Real cosz = coszrsxy_arr(i, j, 0);
5773  amrex::Real elai = LAI_arr(i, j, 0);
5774  amrex::Real esai = SAI_arr(i, j, 0);
5775  amrex::Real tv = t_canop_arr(i, j, 0);
5776  amrex::Real tg = t_ground_skin_arr(i, j, 0);
5777  amrex::Real fveg = veg_frac_arr(i, j, d_khi_lsm);
5778  int vegtyp = static_cast<int>(vegtype_arr(i, j, d_khi_lsm));
5779  int veg_idx = vegtyp - 1; // convert to 0-based index
5780 
5781  // Incoming solar radiation
5782  amrex::Real solad[2], solai[2];
5783  solad[0] = swdsvisxyref_arr(i, j, 0); // direct visible
5784  solad[1] = swdsnirxyref_arr(i, j, 0); // direct NIR
5785  solai[0] = swdsvisdxyref_arr(i, j, 0); // diffuse visible
5786  solai[1] = swdsnirdxyref_arr(i, j, 0); // diffuse NIR
5787 
5788  // Snow variables (set to zero for now - can be added later)
5789  amrex::Real fsno = zero; // snow cover fraction
5790  amrex::Real snowh = zero; // snow height (mm)
5791  amrex::Real sneqvo = zero; // snow mass at last time step (mm)
5792  amrex::Real sneqv = zero; // snow mass (mm)
5793  amrex::Real qsnow = zero; // snowfall (mm/s)
5794  amrex::ignore_unused(snowh, qsnow);
5795 
5796  // Wetness fraction (simplified - using precipitation as indicator)
5797  amrex::Real fwet = (precipref_arr(i, j, 0) > zero) ? 0.1 : zero;
5798 
5799  // Soil moisture for top layer
5800  amrex::Real smc[1];
5801  smc[0] = soilw_arr(i, j, d_khi_lsm) * poro_soil_arr(i, j, d_khi_lsm);
5802 
5803  int nsoil = 1; // using top layer only for albedo calc
5804  int ice = 0; // not ice
5805  int ist = 1; // soil surface type
5806 
5807  // Initialize outputs
5808  bgap = zero;
5809  wgap = zero;
5810  for (int ib = 0; ib < NBAND; ib++) {
5811  albgrd[ib] = zero;
5812  albgri[ib] = zero;
5813  albd[ib] = zero;
5814  albi[ib] = zero;
5815  fabd[ib] = zero;
5816  fabi[ib] = zero;
5817  ftdd[ib] = zero;
5818  ftid[ib] = zero;
5819  ftii[ib] = zero;
5820  albsnd[ib] = zero;
5821  albsni[ib] = zero;
5822  frevd[ib] = zero;
5823  frevi[ib] = zero;
5824  fregd[ib] = zero;
5825  fregi[ib] = zero;
5826  ftdi[ib] = zero;
5827  }
5828  fsun = zero;
5829 
5830  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5831  // ALBEDO CALCULATION (inline to make it device-callable)
5832  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5833 
5834  // snow age (allow nighttime aging)
5835  snow_age_noahmp(dt_loc, tg, sneqvo, sneqv, d_tau0, d_grain_growth, d_extra_growth,
5836  d_dirt_soot, d_swemx, tauss_arr(i,j,0), fage);
5837 
5838  if (cosz > zero) {
5839 
5840  // weight reflectance/transmittance by LAI and SAI
5841  vai = elai + esai;
5842  wl = elai / std::max(vai,MPE);
5843  ws = esai / std::max(vai,MPE);
5844 
5845  // snow albedos: only if COSZ > 0 and FSNO > 0
5846  if(d_opt_alb == 1) {
5847  snowalb_bats_noahmp(NBAND, fsno, cosz, fage,
5848  d_bats_cosz, d_bats_vis_new, d_bats_nir_new,
5849  d_bats_vis_age, d_bats_nir_age,
5850  d_bats_vis_dir, d_bats_nir_dir,
5851  albsnd, albsni);
5852  }
5853 
5854  // ground surface albedo
5855  // Get soil albedo parameters (using soil color index = 4 as default for now)
5856  int soil_color_idx = 3; // index into albedo arrays (0-based for index 4 soil color)
5857  amrex::Real albsat[2], albdry[2], alblak[2];
5858  albsat[0] = d_albsat_vis[soil_color_idx];
5859  albsat[1] = d_albsat_nir[soil_color_idx];
5860  albdry[0] = d_albdry_vis[soil_color_idx];
5861  albdry[1] = d_albdry_nir[soil_color_idx];
5862  alblak[0] = d_alblak[0];
5863  alblak[1] = d_alblak[1];
5864 
5865  groundalb_noahmp(nsoil, NBAND, ice, ist, fsno, smc, albsnd, albsni, cosz, tg,
5866  albsat, albdry, alblak, albgrd, albgri);
5867 
5868  const bool has_canopy = vegetype_arr(i, j, 0) == 1 && fveg > zero && vai > zero;
5869  if (has_canopy) {
5870  // Get parameters for this vegetation type
5871  for (int ib = 0; ib < NBAND; ib++) {
5872  amrex::Real rhol_val = (ib == 0) ? d_rhol_vis[veg_idx] : d_rhol_nir[veg_idx];
5873  amrex::Real rhos_val = (ib == 0) ? d_rhos_vis[veg_idx] : d_rhos_nir[veg_idx];
5874  amrex::Real taul_val = (ib == 0) ? d_taul_vis[veg_idx] : d_taul_nir[veg_idx];
5875  amrex::Real taus_val = (ib == 0) ? d_taus_vis[veg_idx] : d_taus_nir[veg_idx];
5876  rho[ib] = std::max(rhol_val*wl + rhos_val*ws, MPE);
5877  tau[ib] = std::max(taul_val*wl + taus_val*ws, MPE);
5878  }
5879 
5880  // loop over NBAND wavebands to calculate surface albedos and solar
5881  // fluxes for unit incoming direct (IC=0) and diffuse (IC=1)
5882 
5883  for (int ib = 0; ib < NBAND; ib++) {
5884  // direct (IC=0)
5885  twostream_noahmp(ib, 0, vegtyp, cosz, vai, fwet, tv, albgrd, albgri,
5886  rho, tau, fveg, ist,
5887  Khai_L_arr(i,j,0), d_omegas[ib], d_betads, d_betais,
5888  d_opt_rad, d_rc[veg_idx], ztop_arr(i,j,0), d_hvb[veg_idx], d_den[veg_idx],
5889  fabd, albd, ftdd, ftid, gdir, frevd, fregd, bgap, wgap,
5890  xl_diag_val, chil_diag_val, phi1_diag_val, phi2_diag_val);
5891 
5892  // diffuse (IC=1)
5893  twostream_noahmp(ib, 1, vegtyp, cosz, vai, fwet, tv, albgrd, albgri,
5894  rho, tau, fveg, ist,
5895  Khai_L_arr(i,j,0), d_omegas[ib], d_betads, d_betais,
5896  d_opt_rad, d_rc[veg_idx], ztop_arr(i,j,0), d_hvb[veg_idx], d_den[veg_idx],
5897  fabi, albi, ftdi, ftii, gdir, frevi, fregi, bgap, wgap,
5898  xl_diag_val, chil_diag_val, phi1_diag_val, phi2_diag_val);
5899  }
5900 
5901  // sunlit fraction of canopy. set FSUN = 0 if FSUN < 0.01.
5902  ext = gdir/cosz * std::sqrt(one-rho[0]-tau[0]);
5903  fsun = (one-std::exp(-ext*vai)) / std::max(ext*vai,MPE);
5904  ext = fsun;
5905 
5906  if (ext < 0.01) {
5907  wl = zero;
5908  } else {
5909  wl = ext;
5910  }
5911  fsun = wl;
5912  } else {
5913  for (int ib = 0; ib < NBAND; ib++) {
5914  albd[ib] = albgrd[ib];
5915  albi[ib] = albgri[ib];
5916  ftdd[ib] = one;
5917  ftii[ib] = one;
5918  fregd[ib] = albgrd[ib];
5919  fregi[ib] = albgri[ib];
5920  }
5921  }
5922 
5923  } // cosz>0
5924 
5925  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5926  // SURRAD CALCULATION
5927  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5928 
5929  fsha = 1.0-fsun;
5930  laisun = elai*fsun;
5931  laisha = elai*fsha;
5932  vai = elai+ esai;
5933 
5934  surrad_noahmp(MPE, fsun, fsha, elai, vai, laisun, laisha, solad, solai,
5935  fabd, fabi, ftdd, ftid, ftii, albgrd, albgri, albd, albi,
5936  frevd, frevi, fregd, fregi,
5937  parsun, parsha, sav, sag, fsa, fsr, fsrv, fsrg);
5938 
5939  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5940  // LONGWAVE RADIATION CALCULATION (NOAHMP formulation)
5941  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5942  // NOAHMP longwave scheme includes multiple reflections between canopy and ground
5943  // References: NOAHMP module_sf_noahmplsm.F lines 2137-2144 (emissivity)
5944  // lines 3874-3875, 4041 (canopy LW)
5945  // lines 4086-4087, 4104 (ground LW)
5946  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5947 
5948  // Get incoming longwave radiation from atmosphere (W/m²)
5949  // lwdn is positive downward (standard atmospheric convention)
5950  amrex::Real lwdn = lwref_arr(i, j, 0);
5951 
5952  // Calculate emissivities
5953  // Vegetation emissivity (NOAHMP line 2139)
5954  // EMV depends on total vegetation area index (LAI + SAI)
5955  // EMV = 1 for dense canopy, EMV → 0 for sparse/no vegetation
5956  amrex::Real emv = 1.0 - std::exp(-(elai + esai));
5957 
5958  // Ground emissivity (NOAHMP lines 2140-2144)
5959  // EMG is weighted by snow cover fraction (fsno)
5960  // Note: ice = 1 if IST = 2 (lake/ice), for now assume ice = 0 (soil)
5961  // Note: fsno and ist are already declared earlier (lines 5159, 5174)
5962  amrex::Real emg;
5963  if (ist == 1) {
5964  emg = d_eg_soil * (1.0 - fsno) + d_snow_emis * fsno;
5965  } else {
5966  emg = d_eg_lake * (1.0 - fsno) + d_snow_emis * fsno;
5967  }
5968 
5969  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5970  // Canopy net longwave radiation (IRC) - NOAHMP lines 3874-3875, 4041
5971  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5972  // NOAHMP SIGN CONVENTION: IRC is NET UPWARD longwave flux (positive = energy loss)
5973  // IRC = emitted_upward - absorbed_from_atmosphere - absorbed_from_ground
5974  // NOAHMP energy balance: SAV - IRC - SHC - EVC = 0
5975  //
5976  // Physical interpretation of AIR_C term:
5977  // -EMV*LWDN: canopy absorbs atmospheric LW (gain, hence negative)
5978  // -EMV*(1-EMV)*(1-EMG)*LWDN: multiple reflection of atmospheric LW
5979  // (transmitted through canopy, reflected by ground, absorbed by canopy)
5980  // -EMV*EMG*SB*TG^4: canopy absorbs ground emission (gain, hence negative)
5981  //
5982  // Physical interpretation of CIR_C*TV^4 term:
5983  // 2*EMV*SB*TV^4: canopy emits in both directions (up and down)
5984  // -EMV^2*(1-EMG)*SB*TV^4: multiple reflection of canopy downward emission
5985  // (reflected by ground and re-absorbed by canopy)
5986  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5987  amrex::Real air_c = -emv * (1.0 + (1.0 - emv) * (1.0 - emg)) * lwdn
5988  - emv * emg * SB * amrex::Math::powi<4>(tg);
5989  amrex::Real cir_c = (two - emv * (one - emg)) * emv * SB;
5990  amrex::Real irc = air_c + cir_c * amrex::Math::powi<4>(tv);
5991 
5992  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5993  // Ground net longwave radiation (IRG) - NOAHMP lines 4086-4087, 4104
5994  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
5995  // NOAHMP SIGN CONVENTION: IRG is NET UPWARD longwave flux (positive = energy loss)
5996  // IRG = emitted_upward - absorbed_from_atmosphere - absorbed_from_canopy
5997  // NOAHMP energy balance: SAG - IRG - SHG - EVG = 0
5998  //
5999  // Physical interpretation of AIR_G term:
6000  // -EMG*(1-EMV)*LWDN: ground absorbs transmitted atmospheric LW (gain, hence negative)
6001  // -EMG*EMV*SB*TV^4: ground absorbs canopy downward emission (gain, hence negative)
6002  //
6003  // Physical interpretation of CIR_G*TG^4 term:
6004  // EMG*SB*TG^4: ground emits upward
6005  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6006  amrex::Real air_g = -emg * (1.0 - emv) * lwdn - emg * emv * SB * amrex::Math::powi<4>(tv);
6007  amrex::Real cir_g = emg * SB;
6008  amrex::Real irg = cir_g * amrex::Math::powi<4>(tg) + air_g;
6009 
6010  amrex::Real tir1 = emv * SB * amrex::Math::powi<4>(tv);
6011  amrex::Real tir2 = emg * SB * amrex::Math::powi<4>(tg);
6012  amrex::Real lwdn1 = lwdn;
6013  amrex::Real lwdn2 = (1.0 - emv) * lwdn + tir1;
6014  amrex::Real lwup2 = tir2 + (1.0 - emg) * lwdn2;
6015  amrex::Real lwup1 = lwdn + irc + irg;
6016 
6017  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6018  // Store shortwave and longwave radiation to net_rad arrays
6019  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6020  // SLM SIGN CONVENTION: net_rad is NET ABSORBED radiation (positive = energy gain)
6021  // net_rad = absorbed_radiation (all sources) - emitted_radiation
6022  // SLM energy balance: net_rad - SH - LH = heat storage change
6023  //
6024  // SIGN CONVERSION: IRC/IRG (net upward) → net_lw (net absorbed)
6025  // net_absorbed = -net_upward
6026  // When IRC > 0 (net upward flux, energy loss), net_lw1 < 0 (energy loss)
6027  // When IRC < 0 (net downward flux, energy gain), net_lw1 > 0 (energy gain)
6028  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
6029 
6030  // Shortwave absorbed (W/m²)
6031  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_sw1) = sav; // canopy absorbed solar
6032  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_sw2) = sag; // ground absorbed solar
6033 
6034  // Longwave absorbed (W/m²)
6035  // Sign flip converts NOAHMP convention (net upward) to SLM convention (net absorbed)
6036  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::tir1) = tir1;
6037  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::tir2) = tir2;
6038  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_lwup1) = lwup1;
6039  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_lwup2) = lwup2;
6040  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_lwdn1) = lwdn1;
6041  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_lwdn2) = lwdn2;
6042  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_lw1) = -irc; // canopy absorbed longwave
6043  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_lw2) = -irg; // ground absorbed longwave
6044 
6045  // Total net radiation (W/m²)
6046  // net_rad = shortwave_absorbed + longwave_absorbed
6047  // = sav + (-irc) = sav - irc
6048  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_rad1) = sav - irc; // canopy: SW + LW
6049  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_rad2) = sag - irg; // ground: SW + LW
6050 
6051  // Directional shortwave diagnostics use positive physical directions:
6052  // downwelling is positive in net_swdn and upwelling is positive in net_swup.
6053  // net_sw1 and net_sw2 remain positive for absorbed shortwave.
6054  // The surrad terms satisfy SW_in = reflected + canopy absorbed + ground absorbed.
6055  // Downwelling shortwave for stomatal resistance calculation
6056  // Total incoming SW = direct + diffuse for both visible and NIR
6057  const amrex::Real sw_in = solad[0] + solad[1] + solai[0] + solai[1];
6058  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_swdn1) = sw_in;
6059 
6060  // Reflected shortwave at the canopy top.
6061  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_swup1) = fsr;
6062 
6063  // Downwelling SW reaching ground (transmitted through canopy)
6064  amrex::Real sw_down_ground = zero;
6065  for (int ib = 0; ib < NBAND; ib++) {
6066  sw_down_ground += solad[ib] * (ftdd[ib] + ftid[ib])
6067  + solai[ib] * ftii[ib];
6068  }
6069  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_swdn2) = sw_down_ground;
6070  net_rad_arr(i, j, 0, SLM_NetRad::net_swup2) = sw_down_ground - sag;

6073  // --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

6082  alb_vis_sfc_diff_arr(i, j, d_khi_lsm) = albi[0];
6083  alb_nir_sfc_diff_arr(i, j, d_khi_lsm) = albi[1];

6085  // Surface emissivity for the vegetated canopy-ground system, including
6086  // the Noah-MP multiple-reflection term.
6087  amrex::Real emiss_sfc = emv + emg * (1.0 - emv)
6088  + emv * (1.0 - emv) * (1.0 - emg);

6090  emis_sfc_arr(i, j, d_khi_lsm) = emis_sfc_arr(i, j, 0);

6092  t_skin_arr(i, j, 0) = std::pow(
6093  std::max(MPE, (lwup1 - (one - emiss_sfc) * lwdn) /
6094  (emiss_sfc * SB)), fourth);
